records.text: David spoke the words of this song to the Lord on the day the Lord rescued him from the hand of all his enemies and from Saul’s hand,
and said: “Lord, my rock, my fortress, the One who delivers me for my sake!
My God will be my Guard; in Him I will trust. My Defender, the horn of my salvation, my Helper, my refuge of salvation—Thou wilt save me from injustice.
Job continued and said in his prelude:
“Who might place me in a month of former days, when God guarded me?
As when His lamp shone above my head, when by His light I walked in darkness,
when I was weighty in my ways, when God made an inspection of my house,
“I established a covenant for my eyes, and I will not direct my attention toward a virgin.
What did God apportion from above, and what is the Mighty One’s inheritance from the highest places?
Is it not destruction for the unjust and alienation for those practicing lawlessness?
Will He not see my way and count all my steps?
